retained_copies.description: Retained source copies. Open handles can still change these bytes.

parked_path.description: Where the directory now lives, under the parked root.

warnings.description:
Notes for the caller; never a reason the park failed. An adapter that
ran `park_check` first puts its git warning here.

RetainedCopy.description: A retained cross-volume copy. Sizes are snapshots; open writers can change them.

path.description: Absolute path to the retained folder.

bytes.description: Total file bytes at the snapshot; an open writer can change this later.

EventId.description:
History event id (ULID string).

Invariant: lexical order equals creation order inside one store.

DeploymentId.description:
Opaque deployment id.

Invariant: the string starts with `dep:v1/`. Its internal layout is a core
detail; adapters and the UI compare it as a string and never split it.
